Beautifully photographed, masterfully staged, well acted, and deeply felt, Coward is a triumph.

listings.description: Major critics praise concert pianist Orgel for his “subtlety and attention to nuance,” “rare pathos,” “brilliant technique, sense of humor and fantasy,” and “warmth and beauty of sound.” The program features Claude Debussy’s complete impressionist masterpiece Preludes, Book 1, and six Preludes and Fugues from J. S. Bach’s Well-Tempered Klavier, Book 2, in an evening of dazzling contrasts and compositional prowess. A preview video playlist of the Debussy with program notes can be found on our website.

listings.description:

listings.title: Sing We and Chant It
listings.description: Aurora Chamber Singers present a program spanning the golden age of English Renaissance music — from the sacred stillness of William Byrd’s Ave Verum Corpus and Mass for Four Voices to the wit, longing, and sheer delight of English madrigals by Weelkes, Greaves, Jones, and Morley. We are delighted to share the stage with Champlain Consort, an ensemble that specializes in Renaissance and Elizabethan music on period instruments.

listings.title: Major Jackson | A Bowl of Goodness: Nourishing Poems with a Side of Soup, Celebrating Community, Friendship, and Resilience
listings.description: Phoenix Books is excited to welcome poet Major Jackson to Phoenix Books Burlington on Tuesday, November 17 at 7:00 PM for an evening of conversation about his latest anthology, A Bowl of Goodness: Nourishing Poems with a Side of Soup, Celebrating Community, Friendship, and Resilience! Major Jackson will be joined by reading partners, Maria Hummel, John Gennari, and Senator Rocket.

listings.title: Hug Your Farmer: The Last Waltz Revisited
listings.description:
This year’s Hug Your Farmer celebrates the 50th anniversary of The Last Waltz, The Band’s legendary farewell concert and one of the most beloved moments in American music history. An all-star lineup of Vermont musicians and special guests to revisit the songs, spirit, and communal magic of that classic night. Expect a joyful, genre-spanning tribute filled with rock and roll, roots, soul, folk, gospel, blues, and Americana — the music that shaped The Band and continues to inspire generations.

 100% of proceeds support Vermont Farmers.

listings.title: Celebrate Craft Holiday Show

Creative shopping. Start and finish holiday gift buying here.

listings.title: The World is Not Enough - A James Bond Gala
listings.description: The name's Bond, James Bond... You're invited to an evening of espionage and elegance! Black Martini Promotions presents its annual fundraiser, The World Is Not Enough: Holidays Without Hunger Gala, benefiting Feeding Champlain Valley. Join us for this black-tie, James Bond-themed event at the Burlington Country Club on Saturday, November 21, starting at 7:00 PM. Together we'll enjoy an evening filled with live music by Ultraviolet, dancing, a diamond giveaway, and making a difference. Come dressed as your favorite Bond character and prepare to save humanity, because all proceeds from ticket sales and event activities will directly benefit Feeding Champlain…

listings.title: Burlington Choral Society presents Voices of Change: Songs that Shaped History
listings.venue: Elley-Long Music Center, Saint Michael's College
listings.description: Some songs entertain us. Others change us. Voices of Change traces the remarkable journey of choral music that has given voice to hope, resistance, faith, and freedom across generations. Through unforgettable works and the stories behind them, this concert celebrates the moments when ordinary people sang together and, in doing so, helped change history.

listings.title: The Vermont Choral Union: The American Mercury

listings.title: November Bird Monitoring Walk
listings.description:
All birders welcome on our monthly(ish) monitoring walk. 

All birders — current, experienced, newbie and would-be — welcome!

Join our monthly monitoring walk to record birds at the Museum’s trails, forest, and meadow. Learn something new, share what you know, or both! Most fun for adults, older children.

Please bring your own binoculars and dress for the weather. We recommend bringing tick repellent and a water bottle.

listings.title: Paul Winter’s Winter Solstice Celebration
listings.when: Fri., Dec. 4, 7:30 p.m. and Sat., Dec. 5, 3 p.m.
listings.description: The Paul Winter Consort, with beloved vocalist Theresa Thomason, brings the timeless music of their legendary New York solstice events, in a joyous and profound celebration of the season of renewal and the greater family of life on Earth. The Consort of Paul on soprano sax, Theresa, cello, bass, piano, organ, and percussion presents two identical shows. See website or below for a retrospective video, Solstice Saga, interweaving iconic performances from the first forty years of solstice celebrations at the Cathedral of St. John the Divine, New York City.

listings.title: Lane Series: Còig
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: They’re back! Còig, the Celtic acoustic powerhouse from Cape Breton Island, returns for another beautiful holiday show, which Lane Series audiences have come to adore as a way to welcome in the season. With a fiery style at its core, Còig easily shifts from the repertoire of past generations to original and upbeat compositions, featuring the band’s use of over a dozen instruments. With driving tunes, haunting songs, and infectious energy, Còig is an unparalleled musical force. Fronted by Darren McMullen and Rachel Davis, the band also includes Québécois guitarist/bouzouki player Thierry Clouette and iconic fiddler Margie Beaton.

listings.title: Bella Voce Concert "Cool Yule"
listings.when: Sat., Dec. 5, 3 p.m. and Sun., Dec. 6, 3 p.m.
listings.venue: McCarthy Arts Center, Saint Michael's College
listings.description: This joyful concert features fresh, jazzy arrangements of beloved holiday favorites by Vermont composer Dr. James Stewart. A highlight of the program is his delightfully wicked arrangement of Deck the Halls, bringing together the voices of Bella Voce with Dr. Stewart and Collaborative Pianist Sam Whitesell at the piano, joined by Sam's twin brother, Jake Whitesell, on saxophone for a performance full of holiday spirit and irresistible energy. The instrumental trio also shines in Stewart's lush and nostalgic Sentimental Christmas Medley, featuring the timeless classics Have Yourself a Merry Little Christmas and I'll Be Home for Christmas. The program is…

listings.title: Cheryl A. Ossola in Conversation with Lisa DeNatale | How Long a Shadow
listings.description: Phoenix Books is excited to welcome author Cheryl A. Ossola to Phoenix Books Burlington on Sunday, December 6 at 3:00 PM in collaboration with our friends at The Vermont Italian Cultural Association! Cheryl will be in coversation with Lisa DeNatale for an afternoon of book talk focused on Cheryl's new book, How Long a Shadow.

listings.title: Vermont Symphony Orchestra's Holiday Pops
listings.description: We’re celebrating the season with music that is both reflective and radiant—sending audiences home with a melody in their hearts and a sense of holiday warmth. Our upcoming Holiday Pops concerts feature the full orchestra alongside VSO’s 80-voice chorus, leading spirited sing-alongs and performing festive favorites by Leroy Anderson, George Frideric Handel, Duke Ellington, and Georges Bizet. Beloved traditional carols round out this joyful, family-friendly holiday tradition.

listings.title: Lane Series: Lorelei Ensemble
listings.venue: The University of Vermont Recital Hall
listings.description: We love a choral holiday event, and we have been trying to book the Lorelei for a long time! Heralded for its “white-hot intensity” (The New York Times), the Grammy-nominated Lorelei Ensemble is recognized across the globe for its bold and inventive programs that champion the extraordinary flexibility and virtuosity of the human voice. Recognized for its rich and diverse vocal palette, the ensemble is celebrated for its compelling delivery of “exact, smooth, and stylish” programming (The Boston Globe). This will be a vocal holiday program of unparalleled creativity and originality.
